title: Calendar
connectAccount: Connect an account to use Calendar

reauth.title: Calendar requires re-authorization
reauth.description: Your account was connected before calendar permissions were added. Re-authorize to grant calendar access; your emails and data will not be affected.

empty.notConfigured: Calendar is not configured for this account.
empty.imapCalDav: For IMAP accounts, configure CalDAV in Settings.

error.accessAfterReauth: Calendar access is still denied after re-authorization. Make sure the Google Calendar API is enabled in your Google Cloud Console project. Visit console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Enable the "Google Calendar API".
